_about: LT-n-2, LGIC_LGCTFM round 2. Every number round 1's judgment records cite, bound to the run it was measured on and to that run's content hash. NO GRADE MOVES.
denominator_source: every maximal digit run in every STRING field of the 14 round-1 judgment acceptance rows, read from the 14 proof instances themselves. The instances are enumerated by EXISTENCE (git ls-files over the project's deliverables, filtered to *.proof_of_spec.json), never from a typed list; the 14 judgment criterion ids come from R2_BASE.json's round_1_judgment_criteria.by_id, which the issuer measured from the 14 orders' judgment="true" elements. The FIELD read is every string-valued key of the acceptance row (output_evidence, denominator, invocation, criterion_verbatim, expect, method, status, status_reason, criterion_id) -- the widest field set the row offers, chosen so no citation can hide in a field the sweep skipped. This number is the ENUMERATION, not a count of what was pinned: 492 of it is subtracted by declared class before anything is pinned.
domain_choice_stated: The class pinned is a quantity measured on an artifact ROUND 1 PRODUCED (a run directory's output, or a cell deliverable). A quantity measured on a PRE-EXISTING repo file the cell merely read is excluded BY CLASS (QUANTITY_ON_A_PRE_EXISTING_REPO_FILE, 6 tokens), because R-40's subject is a run or a produced artifact and such a file already resolves through the commit pin its own row carries. Choosing the domain is itself a claim (R-50), so it is printed here to be refused rather than assumed.

excluded.E3R1-AC6: NOT re-graded against R-40, by 1.0.0_SA_CTO's round-1 analysis item 2, verbatim: "S11's run-ids on every number; E3 is NOT re-graded against R-40." Its judgment was SOUND AT ITS OWN VINTAGE -- it ran before LT-e-4 made the untypeable plant opt-in, which is what moved the population from 271 tensions to 179. Re-grading it would falsify a correct grade. This is a STATED EXCLUSION, not a silent omission: the criterion cites 5 of the residue's 28 run-measured tokens (rules_colliding 1, 271 tensions, 1084 factor cells twice, 0 defective) and this one member accounts for all of them.
